title: ChemInform Abstract: (Z,Z)‐d,l‐2,3‐Dimethyl‐1,4‐butanedithial S,S′‐Dioxide: A Novel Biologically Active Organosulfur Compound from Onion. Formation of vic‐Disulfoxides in Onion Extracts.
abstract: AbstractThe new biologically active title compound (DL)‐(III), which can be isolated from onion extracts, is stereoselectively synthesized by a simple oxidation of the known compound (I).
